# Balance mod: the game's file, copied whole, with only the colony window's
# building lock added to each type's can_destroy (balance_building_not_kept).
# Generated by write_building_locks.py -- rerun it after every game update.
coastal_fort = {
	allow = { balance_building_not_forbidden = { TYPE = coastal_fort } }	# Balance mod: colony window build priorities
	audio_tier = 1
	is_foreign = no
	max_levels = 1
	pop_type = soldiers
	
	category = defense_category
	
	employment_size = coastal_fort_employment
	
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	
	
	build_time = small_fort_building

	
	location_potential = {
		is_port = yes
	}
	
	
	unique_production_methods = {
		
		coastal_fort_maintenance = {
			stone = 0.2
			firearms = 0.2
			cannons = 0.5
			tools = 0.2
			tar = 0.2
			category = building_maintenance
		}

	}

	construction_demand = fort_construction
	

	modifier = {
		hostile_disembark_time_modifier = 1.0
		hostile_fleet_attrition = 1
		blocks_privateer_raids = yes
		local_maritime_presence = 0.15
	}
	can_destroy = { balance_building_not_kept = yes  # Balance mod: colony window building lock
	}
}
